summary: BrenX Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine board action on August 4, 2026: approval to increase shares reserved under its 2013 Global Incentive Equity Scheme by 395,031 to a total of 405,338 ordinary shares. No shareholder meeting, deal, or corporate action is involved. The filing incorporates the report by reference into existing Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. This is an administrative equity plan update with no special-situation significance.
